description: Complete your Addison crib with this toddler bed conversion kit. Designed to convert your Addison crib into a toddler bed, this kit allows your little one to transition smoothly from crib to bed. Made from solid hardwood with a BrownMaple finish, it matches perfectly with the Addison collection. Easy to install with included hardware.
